projects.name: Semitone
projects.oneLiner: An iPhone app that listens to music and writes it out as notes.
projects.description: Play or import a recording and Semitone turns it into a piano roll with chord names, a beat grid and playback. Piano mode runs a Swift port of the Transkun piano model on the iPhone's Neural Engine. Any-instrument mode splits a band recording into melody, chords, bass and countermelody. Everything runs on the device.
facts: Onset accuracy 0.97 F1 on a 264-second piano test, up from 0.85 with Basic Pitch
Transcribes a minute of audio in about 4 seconds on iPhone

media.alt: Semitone's Home screen: a grid of saved recordings shown as tiles, with a record button and mode switch at the bottom.
A transcription playing back as a horizontal piano roll, with melody, chords and bass in different colours.
Falling-notes view: coloured notes drop toward an on-screen piano keyboard.
The piano roll paused, showing chord names above the notes.
Semitone's settings for a recording: roll style, note detection and beat grid.

projects.name: Garymandering
projects.oneLiner: Draw congressional maps that win the most seats for one party, then compare them to neutral maps.
projects.description: Pick any of 44 states and its precinct map, population and 2020 votes load instantly. The app searches for legal district maps (contiguous, equal population) that maximize one party's seats, and shows how far they stray from 800 maps drawn without regard to party. It all runs in the browser.

media.alt: Garymandering showing Pennsylvania split into 17 districts shaded by margin, with Republicans winning 12 of 17, beside a chart comparing seat counts across neutral maps.

projects.name: Better Docs
projects.oneLiner: A Chrome extension that sends text from any tab straight into a spot in your Google Doc.
projects.description: Plant a marker anywhere in a Google Doc, then copy or highlight text in any other tab and send it there, without switching tabs. Works with many docs and markers at once. Autogramulate accepts Grammarly suggestions automatically while you type.
facts: Floating panel in Docs, side panel everywhere else
projects.status: Preparing for the Chrome Web Store

media.alt: Better Docs promo film title card.
Better Docs store banner showing the extension's panel beside a Google Doc.

projects.name: Crunchychud
projects.oneLiner: Stats for your Crunchyroll watch history: hours watched, top shows and a viewing heatmap.
projects.description: A Chrome extension that reads your own Crunchyroll history and turns it into a dashboard: total hours, top shows, genres, a heatmap of when you watch, what to resume next, and shareable stat cards. No server; your data stays in your browser.

media.alt: Crunchychud dashboard with total hours watched, a list of top shows and a calendar heatmap.

projects.name: Mouse Circuit
projects.oneLiner: A daily maze racer: everyone gets the same maze each day.
projects.description: Drive a robot mouse from the start bay to the cheese dock as fast as you can. Slide the corners to charge a boost, avoid ice and mud, race your own ghost and twelve rival bots, and spend cheese on new paint in the garage. Every sound is synthesized in the browser.
facts: A new seeded maze every day

media.alt: Mouse Circuit mid-race: a small white robot mouse in a brass-walled maze on a green circuit board, with a timer reading 4.5 seconds.

projects.name: Fusabowl Rewards
projects.oneLiner: A rewards app for a local restaurant, plus its promo video.
projects.description: Points, tiers and deals for regulars, with a staff dashboard.

projects.name: Soma
projects.oneLiner: A synthesizer for iPhone that can dial in a sound from a text description.
projects.description: Two oscillators, filters, an LFO and a mod matrix, with MIDI input and an AI prompt for patches.

projects.name: Pickleball Club
projects.oneLiner: RSVPs, Elo-balanced doubles and rankings for a school pickleball club.
projects.description: Members RSVP for Friday sessions, get matched into balanced doubles teams, and climb an Elo leaderboard.
